Caffeine content of common coffee drinks

An 8 oz cup of drip coffee contains about 95 mg of caffeine. A single 1 oz shot of espresso contains about 63 mg. Decaf drip coffee still contains 2 to 5 mg per 8 oz cup.

Daily limits

Health agencies commonly cite 400 mg per day as a level not associated with adverse effects for healthy adults. During pregnancy the commonly cited limit is 200 mg per day.
